company.name: The Coterie
company.description:
The Coterie provides end-to-end investment management for GPs and LPs.

Our founders—Ethan Agarwal, Jeson Patel, and Chris Boies—have all founded and sold companies before. 

We’ve raised $50M in funding, led by Andreessen Horowitz. Other investors include Garry Tan (Midas List), Gokul Rajaram (IFKYK), Mar Hershenson (Midas List), Stanley Tang (Doordash co-founder), and more.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature that enables faster and cost-effective creation and management of special purpose vehicles for private fund investments.
productsAndServices.name: SPVs (Special Purpose Vehicles)

productsAndServices.description: A comprehensive tool for general partners to manage the entire investment lifecycle of limited partners, including merchandising, subscription documents, capital calls, and reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Investment Lifecycle Management for GPs

productsAndServices.description: A digital solution for creating private placement memorandums, customizing marketing materials, and managing investor subscriptions with legal and compliance support.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Fundraising and Subscription Management

productsAndServices.description: A system that automates the issuance of capital calls and enables limited partners to pay via autopay through a dedicated app, eliminating manual payment reconciliation.
productsAndServices.name: Capital Call Automation and Payment Processing

productsAndServices.description: A platform for limited partners to view fund performance, access capital account statements, tax documents, and securely store fund documents digitally.
productsAndServices.name: Performance Reporting and Digital Document Locker for LPs

productsAndServices.description: A tool for limited partners to analyze investment performance across all funds and plan for future capital calls in one unified platform.
productsAndServices.name: Portfolio Analysis and Capital Call Planning for LPs

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $40,000,000, or 80% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,819,732 to $183,502,037, a 26.91x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
